heading.en: Men are called as high priests because of their exceeding faith and good works—They are to teach the commandments—Through righteousness they are sanctified and enter into the rest of the Lord—Melchizedek was one of these—Angels are declaring glad tidings throughout the land—They will declare the actual coming of Christ. About 82 B.C.
heading.sm: E valaauina alii e avea ma faitaulaga sili ona o lo latou faatuatua tele ma a latou galuega lelei—E tatau ona latou a'oa'o atu poloaiga—E faapaiaina i latou ma ulufale atu i le malologa o le Alii e ala i le amiotonu—O Mekisateko o se tasi o i latou ia—O loo tala'i atu e agelu tala fiafia i le laueleele atoa—O le a latou folafola le afio mai tonu o Keriso. E tusa o le 82 T.L.M.
